title: Treasury Announces 2020 National Illicit Finance Strategy | U.S. Department of the Treasury
主要内容: On February 6, 2020, the U.S. Treasury announced the 2020 National Illicit Finance Strategy, aiming to modernize the AML/CFT framework to address key vulnerabilities and enhance effectiveness. The strategy outlines three priorities: improving transparency in the legal framework, enhancing regulatory efficiency, and strengthening operational capabilities. It identifies significant threats and risks to the U.S. financial system and supports legislative proposals on beneficial ownership and expanding AML/CFT obligations. Financial institutions and examiners will use the strategy to inform risk assessments and evaluate compliance. The initiative reflects a comprehensive effort to tackle financial crime, building on the 2018 National Strategy under CAATSA.
